name: iq2i/herse-bundle
description: Account security building blocks for Symfony and Sylius: password policy, login throttling, trusted devices, password change notification and two-factor authentication

suggest.bacon/bacon-qr-code: To show a QR code on the screen enrolling an authenticator app (two_factor.method: totp)
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: To detect the password changes (password_change_notification) and to register the trusted devices (trusted_devices)
suggest.doctrine/orm: To detect the password changes (password_change_notification) and to register the trusted devices (trusted_devices)
suggest.scheb/2fa-bundle: To enable the two-factor authentication (two_factor), with scheb/2fa-email or scheb/2fa-totp for the method
suggest.scheb/2fa-email: To use the email method of the two-factor authentication (two_factor.method: email)
suggest.scheb/2fa-totp: To use the TOTP method of the two-factor authentication (two_factor.method: totp)
suggest.scheb/2fa-trusted-device: To let a trusted device skip the second factor (two_factor.trusted_devices)
suggest.symfony/form: To use the PasswordPolicyType form type
suggest.symfony/ai-mate: Gives your agent the Herse skill (vendor/bin/mate discover)
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: To limit the login attempts (login_throttling) and the wrong second factors (two_factor.throttling)
